method: For every delivery.sourceFiles entry, compare SHA-256 of raw git show <runtimeCommit>:<path> stdout bytes and current worktree bytes to the recorded SHA-256. No newline, encoding or whitespace normalization. Independent closeout audit; not a claim that the packaging recipe performs this raw Git-blob comparison.
scope: Only the 206 listed runtime/build source inputs; package binaries/Web payloads and broader visual assets have their separate delivery/build manifests.
